title: Article. What is a Great Business?
summary:
Or would you point to a competitive advantage that creates a moat or a very savvy manager? Do great
businesses exist where there is still a keyman risk? A scandal, product defects, or bad customer service,
parentheses, the risk of all of which increase with poor management, all expel pressure from the business.
